server.name: travel-agent-demo
server.title: Wayfinder · Travel lab
server.description: Explore travel intent, fare rules and a complete sandbox refund workflow.

live.instructions: This is a sandbox travel demo, never a live airline service. Start with get-travel-guidance, clarify whether the traveller needs refunds or changes, then search-travel. Missing conditions are unknown. Fare names are not evidence of refundability. Use rank-travel-offers to compare the same offers with/without guidance. Create test bookings only after user confirmation. Before confirm-refund, show the current quote amount, currency and destination and obtain explicit confirmation. Do not claim a traveller has received money. Skills over MCP are available to supporting hosts; get-travel-guidance works for all clients.

tools.name: get-travel-guidance
tools.description: Read sample travel guidance, its provenance and the demo workflow. Not proprietary airline or Threedot knowledge.

tools.name: search-travel
tools.title: Find a fare that fits
tools.description: Search one-way flights for one synthetic adult, with an interactive comparison. Fixture mode needs no token. Duffel mode uses test-only business fares to demonstrate multiple fare brands.

date.description: Future departure date. Defaults to 30 days from today.

knowledge.description: Apply the sample travel guidance to the SAME offers; false shows price-only ordering.

tools.name: rank-travel-offers
tools.description: Re-rank the same stored offers to compare price-only ordering with sample travel guidance. No fresh API search.

tools.name: create-demo-booking
tools.description: Create a TEST booking for a stored offer, using a synthetic traveller. Requires explicit confirmation. Never creates a real ticket. Repeated requests return the same completed booking.

tools.name: get-demo-booking
tools.description: Retrieve a booking created by this demo. The opaque ID is a capability: keep it private. Does not accept external airline booking references.

tools.name: quote-refund
tools.description: Get a pending cancellation quote for a test booking. Does NOT cancel. Show amount, currency and destination before confirmation. Replaces previous quotes.

tools.name: confirm-refund
tools.description: Cancel a TEST booking using the latest unexpired quote, only after explicit confirmation of its amount and destination. Unknown refund amounts are blocked. No real money moves.
